name: Kometa
description: Kometa is an open source Python 3 project that has been designed to ease the creation and maintenance of metadata, collections, and playlists within a Plex Media Server. The script is designed to be run continuously and be able to update information based on sources outside your plex environment. Kometa supports Movie/TV/Music libraries and Playlists. Unraid Setup Guide: https://kometa.wiki/en/latest/kometa/install/Unraid/

variables.name: Internal Config Location (--config)
variables.description: Specify the internal location of the configuration YAML file.

variables.name: Time to Run (--time)
variables.description: Specify the times of day that Kometa will run with comma-separated list of times in HH:MM format.

variables.name: Run Immediately (--run)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to perform a run immediately, bypassing the time to run flag.

variables.name: Run Tests (--run-tests)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to perform a debug test run immediately, bypassing the time to run flag. This will only run collections with test: true in the definition.

variables.name: Debug (--debug)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run with Debug Logs Reporting to the Command Window.

variables.name: Trace (--trace)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run with extra Trace Debug Logs.

variables.name: Log Requests (--log-requests)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run with every network request printed to the Logs. This can potentially have personal information in it.

variables.name: Timeout (--timeout)
variables.description: Change the main Kometa timeout. This timeout is overwritten by those in your config file for those services.

variables.name: No Verify SSL (--no-verify-ssl)
variables.description: Turn SSL Verification off.

variables.name: Collections Only (--collections-only)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to only run collection files, skip metadata, library operations, overlays, and playlists.

variables.name: Metadata Only (--metadata-only)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to only run metadata files, skip library operations, overlays, playlists, and collections.

variables.name: Playlists Only (--playlists-only)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to only run playlist files, skip metadata, library operations, overlays, and collections.

variables.name: Operations Only (--operations-only)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to only run library operations skipping metadata, collections, playlists, and overlays.

variables.name: Overlays Only (--overlays-only)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to only run library overlays skipping metadata, collections, playlists, and library operations.

variables.name: Run Collections (--run-collections)
variables.description: Will immediately run the comma-separated list of Collection Names given, bypassing the time to run flag.

variables.name: Run Libraries (--run-libraries)
variables.description: Will immediately run the comma-separated list of Library Names given, bypassing the time to run flag.

variables.name: Run Files (--run-files)
variables.description: Will immediately run the comma-separated list of File Names given, bypassing the time to run flag.

variables.name: Ignore Schedules (--ignore-schedules)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to ignore all schedules for the run.

variables.name: Ignore Ghost (--ignore-ghost)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to ignore all ghost logging for the run. A ghost log is what’s printed to the console to show progress during steps.

variables.name: Delete Collections (--delete-collections)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to delete all collections in a Library prior to running collections/operations.

variables.name: Delete Labels (--delete-labels)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to delete all labels on every item in a Library prior to running collections/operations.

variables.name: Resume Run (--resume)
variables.description: Name of Collection to immediately resume running from the first instance of the specified collection, bypassing the time to run flag.

variables.name: No Countdown (--no-countdown)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run without displaying a countdown to the next scheduled run.

variables.name: No Missing (--no-missing)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run without utilizing the missing movie/show functions.

variables.name: No Report (--no-report)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run without saving the report.

variables.name: Read Only Config (--read-only-config)
variables.description: Set as 'true' to run without writing to the configuration file.

variables.name: Divider Character (--divider)
variables.description: Character to use as a divider in the logs.

variables.name: Screen Width (--width)
variables.description: Width of the Log Output. Integer between 90 and 300.

variables.name: Low Priority (--low-priority)
variables.description: Run Kometa with lower priority.

variables.name: ENV Plex URL (--plex-url)
variables.description: Plex URL to replace ENV in the config file.

variables.name: ENV Plex Token (--plex-token)
variables.description: Plex Token to replace ENV in the config file.
